description: Source code for PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) PDU translation and processing in a 5G NR context, including functions for filling reserved RE patterns, codewords, power values, and converting FAPI PDU to internal representation.

methods.name: fill_reserved_re_pattern
methods.description: Fills the reserved RE pattern list in a PDSCH PDU based on CSI-RS indices.

methods.name: fill_codewords
methods.description: Populates the codewords in the PDSCH PDU with modulation and redundancy version info.

methods.name: get_power_control_offset_ss_dB
methods.description: Returns power control offset in dB based on profile enumeration.

methods.name: fill_power_values
methods.description: Sets power-related parameters in the PDSCH PDU based on power configuration profiles.

methods.name: get_mapping_type
methods.description: Maps FAPI VRB to PRB mapping types to internal representation.

methods.name: make_vrb_to_prb_config
methods.description: Constructs VRB-to-PRB configuration based on transmission type and bandwidth part.

methods.name: fill_rb_allocation
methods.description: Fills resource block allocation in the PDSCH PDU, either type 0 or type 1.

methods.name: convert_pdsch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts FAPI PDSCH PDU to internal PHY representation, filling all relevant fields.
